files.README.md:
# Thornbury Bottling Works - depot stock take

The Meadowbank depot counts its floor stock at the close of every second
week and the count team exports the result as a single file, most
recently stocktake_2026-09-14.csv.

Columns: sku, units, line_value. units is what the count team recorded
on the floor; line_value is units multiplied by the standard cost of
that SKU. The standard costs are held in standard_costs.csv.

Lines holding twenty units or more are managed as bulk stock; anything
below that is treated as shelf stock.
